changelog:
Long recordings are no longer lost, and a lost one can be recovered. A meeting was only saved AFTER it finished transcribing - which for a long recording could take 15-40 minutes with nothing saved yet. If the app was closed or ran out of memory in that window, the recording was gone with no error shown. Now the meeting is saved the moment you stop recording, and transcribing happens afterwards. Recordings above 30 minutes skip the on-device pass entirely and are transcribed by your desktop, which has the memory for it.

If a past recording was lost this way, the audio is very likely still on your phone: open the app and it will offer to restore it.

Your phone also keeps its copy of the audio until your desktop confirms a finished transcript, instead of deleting it as soon as the upload is accepted. A failed transcript now shows in red rather than as a green "synced".
